'''November 1999 Geelong tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Geelong, Australia on 25 November 1999. [[Michael Josem]] won it. It is known from Michael Josem's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d126">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-27-geelong-australia-25-november-1999d126/ geelong-australia-25-november-1999], DeckTech (Michael "Joz" Josem, 27 November 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-27-geelong-australia-25-november-1999d126/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 25 November 1999
* '''Site:''' Geelong, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 11
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Josem]]
